considerations: Exclude documented workloads that make multi-vault accesses.
Review operation outcomes and identities before inferring secret access.
description: Look for a caller rapidly requesting secrets across several vaults.

evidence.claim: Microsoft observed ARTEX-associated use of exposed cloud credentials, service-principal sign-ins from a reported IP, rapid cloud discovery and attempted access to Azure Key Vault and other resources.
evidence.location: Credential abuse via Entra ID and indicators sections

expected_output: One row per caller IP and five-minute window.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Look for a caller rapidly requesting secrets across several vaults.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Rapid Secret Requests Across Key Vaults

1.json:
AZKVAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where OperationName in~ ("SecretGet", "SecretList", "SecretListVersions") and isnotempty(CallerIpAddress)
| summarize Requests = count(), Vaults = dcount(_ResourceId), Operations = make_set(OperationName, 8), Outcomes = make_set(ResultType, 8) by CallerIpAddress, Window = bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where Requests >= 15 and Vaults >= 3
| order by Vaults desc, Requests desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
